name: batchdata
description: Official BatchData hosted MCP server for U.S. property data covering 169 million+ parcels: property lookup and search, comparables, owner skip tracing and reverse skip tracing, DNC and TCPA phone checks, address verification and geocoding, and investor buy box matching. Remote server: sign in through your MCP client (OAuth) or send a BatchData API token as an Authorization Bearer header. Requires a BatchData account.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP server. An OAuth-capable MCP client opens a browser sign-in with your BatchData account on first use.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP using a BatchData API token instead of OAuth.

BATCHDATA_API_TOKEN.description: BatchData API token for the API token installation (not needed for OAuth). Never commit your token.

tools.name: lookup_property
tools.description: Returns property details for a real-estate property based on its propertyId or its address as (street + city + state + zip) or its parcel number as (countyFipsCode + APN).

tools.name: comparable_property_count
tools.description: Returns the total count of comparable properties and aggregated metrics (estimatedValue, averagePrice, averagePricePerSqft) without returning individual comparable records.

tools.name: comparable_property_preview
tools.description: Returns a quick preview of the first 10 comparable properties with summary fields (address, price, sqft, beds/baths, sale date, distance), plus total count and aggregated metrics.

tools.name: comparable_property_page
tools.description: Paginated access to comparable properties with full details (page size: 10).

tools.name: search_properties_count
tools.description: Returns total count of properties matching search criteria and quicklist breakdowns.

tools.name: search_properties_preview
tools.description: Returns a quick preview of the first 10 properties with essential fields, plus total count.

tools.name: search_properties_page
tools.description: Paginated property search with full details (page size: 10).

tools.name: skip_trace_property
tools.description: Returns contact information for the property owner and any other people associated with a real-estate property based on its address as (street + city + state + zip) or (street + city + state) or (street + zip) or its parcel number as (state + county + APN) or (countyFipsCode + APN).

tools.name: reverse_skip_trace
tools.description: Returns associated person information (name, addresses, phones, emails) for one or more phone numbers or email addresses.

tools.name: verify_phone
tools.description: Returns full verification details of a phone number including reachability, DNC status, carrier info, TCPA litigator status, and more.

tools.name: check_dnc_status
tools.description: Checks only the DNC (Do Not Call) status of a phone number.

tools.name: check_tcpa_status
tools.description: Checks only the TCPA litigator status of a phone number.

tools.name: verify_address
tools.description: Accepts a property address in the format of street + city + state + zip, or street + city + state, or street + zip and returns an address formatted to comply with USPS conventions.

tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Accepts a property address in the format of a single text string representing the street + city + state + zip, or street + city + state, or street + zip and returns the geo-coordinates for the requested address.

tools.name: reverse_geocode_address
tools.description: Accepts geo-coordinates in the form of latitude and longitude values and returns the address at those coordinates.

tools.name: list_property_datasets
tools.description: Returns all available property datasets with field counts and sample fields.

tools.name: list_property_dataset_fields
tools.description: Returns the full list of field paths for a specific property dataset.

tools.name: investor_buybox_count
tools.description: Returns the total count of investors matching the buy box criteria and aggregate result metadata, without returning individual investor records.

tools.name: investor_buybox_preview
tools.description: Returns a quick preview of the first 10 ranked investor profiles matching the buy box criteria, plus total count and aggregate result metadata.

tools.name: investor_buybox_page
tools.description: Paginated access to investors matching the buy box criteria with full details (page size: 10).
